snippet.title: UAZO : free as a bird - first trailer
snippet.description:
The first trailer of my solo-dev game, UAZO : Free as a bird !
Play as a little bird and build a bird house in a cozy exploration and survival game. 

Wishlist on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3182050/UAZO__Free_as_a_Bird/
Follow me to get news about the developpement of the game ! 
X : https://x.com/Rag_Bell
BlueSky : https://bsky.app/profile/ragbell.bsky.social
